rows.name: Pitcher
rows.definition: Initiate or steer what another entity should do, supply, or decide. This is a message function, independent of the sender’s identity.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Request
rows.definition: Ask for work or input. Work and input branches may coexist.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Request work
rows.definition: Commission an activity. Its children are work-request subtypes, not a separate global Activity dimension.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Investigate
rows.definition: Request discovery, diagnosis, or deeper understanding.
rows.example: Investigate why the importer drops messages.
rows.boundary: A request for a known explanation may instead be P.request.input.information. Keep the broad parent when this distinction cannot be established.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Implement
rows.definition: Request new behavior or a work product.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Review
rows.definition: Request an assessment of existing work or a proposal.
rows.boundary: A request to fix review findings is revision, not a request to perform a review.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Revise
rows.definition: Request changes to existing work, including repairs or addressing feedback.
rows.boundary: Feedback is the reason for revision when stated; it is not an independently inferred relation tag.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Verify
rows.definition: Request testing, validation, or reproduction.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Request input
rows.definition: Ask the other entity for information, clarification, a choice, permission, or guidance.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Information or explanation
rows.definition: Ask for an answer, explanation, or known status.
rows.boundary: “Why” does not reliably distinguish an investigation from an explanation. Context or a broad parent can be necessary.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Clarification
rows.definition: Ask to disambiguate or supply a missing detail.
rows.example: Do you mean text contrast or chart colors?
rows.boundary: This is Pitcher for a human, lead agent, or worker. No second Catcher clarification tag or synthetic sub-session is created.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Choice
rows.definition: Ask for selection among identifiable alternatives.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Permission
rows.definition: Ask for authorization to perform an identifiable action.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Guidance
rows.definition: Ask for a procedure, priority, policy, or decision criterion.
rows.example: Which release policy should I follow?
rows.boundary: Can coexist with clarification if both functions have evidence.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Frame or constrain
rows.definition: State what should be achieved and the conditions under which it should be done.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Scope or objective
rows.definition: Specify included work, exclusions, or the desired result.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Constraint
rows.definition: Restrict an action, implementation, process, or output.
rows.boundary: “Do not investigate yet” supplies a negative constraint, not a positive investigation request.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Acceptance criteria
rows.definition: State how the work will be judged or verified.
rows.example: It must reopen the same library after restart.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Steer ongoing work
rows.definition: Control continuation or direction of identifiable existing work.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Continue
rows.definition: Ask for work to proceed.
rows.boundary: Continuation does not imply acceptance of the approach or completion.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Redirect
rows.definition: Change the approach, priority, or scope.
rows.boundary: Can coexist with a new work request, a constraint, and Catcher feedback.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Pause
rows.definition: Suspend work without withdrawing it.
rows.example: Hold off until I check the screenshot.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Cancel
rows.definition: Withdraw or stop the existing work.
rows.example: Stop this task; we no longer need it.
rows.boundary: Canceling the whole task differs from rejecting one proposal.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Catcher
rows.definition: Supply a response, assessment, or account of work in response to another entity or a received task. Includes intermediate work and retained deliberation.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Supply requested input
rows.definition: Answer or provide a decision requested by the other entity.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Answer or explain
rows.definition: Provide information responsive to a request.
rows.example: The importer drops records without a source ID.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Choose an option
rows.definition: Select a recoverable alternative the other entity offered.
rows.boundary: Without the preceding options, “the second one” may remain a context-dependent candidate.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Respond to permission request
rows.definition: Grant, deny, or defer authorization for a known action.
rows.boundary: This is the deliberately narrow exclusivity example. If the scope is unclear or contradictory, retain the parent and mark the child unresolved.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Grant
rows.definition: Authorize the specified action.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Deny
rows.definition: Refuse authorization for the specified action.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Defer
rows.definition: Postpone deciding or granting authorization.
rows.example: Wait until I have reviewed it.
rows.boundary: A conditional grant is not automatically defer; this boundary needs adjudication on real messages.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Evaluate received work or a proposal
rows.definition: Express a disposition about something the other entity supplied. Replaces the old Pitcher disposition family and separate alignment tags.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Accept
rows.definition: Accept a recoverable result, claim, or proposal.
rows.boundary: A nearby new instruction is independently Pitcher. Acceptance need not cover every part of the proposal.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Qualify
rows.definition: Retain part of a response while stating an exception or condition.
rows.example: Good approach, but preserve the old format.
rows.boundary: Can overlap acceptance of one target, concern about another, and a Pitcher constraint. These siblings are not globally exclusive.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Challenge or identify a problem
rows.definition: Express an error, unmet expectation, or disagreement.
rows.boundary: Visual feedback can be a later child if real samples support a useful distinction; a screenshot alone does not imply criticism.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Reject
rows.definition: Decline a supplied proposal or result.
rows.example: That design does not work for me.
rows.boundary: Rejection of a proposal does not imply cancellation of the task. A cancellation request is separately P.control.cancel.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Report work or state
rows.definition: Describe intended work, progress, findings, verification, delivery, or limits. Siblings can co-occur.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Intention
rows.definition: State an intention to take up the work.
rows.example: I will investigate the dropped messages.
rows.boundary: Future intention is neither a request to another entity nor work already performed.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Progress
rows.definition: Describe work done or still underway.
rows.example: The parser is updated; the reader changes remain.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Work product or change
rows.definition: Present an artifact or report changes made.
rows.boundary: An artifact can be delivered without claiming the full task is complete.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Finding or explanation from work
rows.definition: Report an observation, diagnosis, or assessment result.
rows.example: I found that missing IDs cause the drop.
rows.boundary: Do not copy the request’s investigation label onto the response. This is a reported finding; the underlying claim may be wrong.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Verification result
rows.definition: Report a check, test, or reproduction outcome, whether pass, fail, or inconclusive.
rows.example: The import tests fail on the new fixture.
rows.boundary: Success/failure is a scoped result value, not three incompatible whole-message tags. A planned check is not a verification result.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Completion claim
rows.definition: State that identifiable work is complete.
rows.boundary: A final channel, conditional instruction, quoted “done,” or lack of further messages is not sufficient evidence.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Limitation or assumption
rows.definition: State a premise, unverified area, or limit of the response.
rows.boundary: A limitation need not be a blocker. Completion of one component can coexist with a limitation on another.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Retained work deliberation
rows.definition: Express a plan, hypothesis, examination of evidence, or revision of understanding while working on a received task. Channel alone does not supply this tag.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Plan next step
rows.definition: Consider the next action to take oneself.
rows.example: I should inspect the journal next.
rows.boundary: Self-directed planning is not a Pitcher request unless another entity is actually being asked to act.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Consider a hypothesis
rows.definition: Propose a tentative explanation.
rows.example: Maybe the importer drops records before indexing.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Weigh evidence
rows.definition: Assess what observations support or undermine a claim.
rows.example: The journal contains those records, so the drop seems later.
rows.boundary: This is expressed deliberation, not an asserted view into unretained internal reasoning.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Reconsider or self-correct
rows.definition: Revise a previously stated interpretation or plan.
rows.boundary: A different statement alone does not establish a correction of a known prior claim.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: State a difficulty
rows.definition: Explicitly report something that makes the task unclear, inconsistent, or blocked. This replaces a free-standing Obstacle dimension.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Ambiguous or missing information
rows.definition: State that a needed referent, goal, or detail is unclear.
rows.example: Contrast could mean text or chart colors.
rows.boundary: A subsequent clarification question is independently P.request.input.clarification. A question alone does not prove ambiguity.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Inconsistency
rows.definition: Explicitly identify conflicting requirements, claims, or evidence.
rows.boundary: Tag the expressed conflict. Verifying whether the requirements actually contradict is a different task.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Missing guidance
rows.definition: State that a needed policy, priority, or decision criterion is unspecified.
rows.example: I do not know which release policy applies.
rows.boundary: Asking for guidance is independently Pitcher. The message may state a difficulty without asking anything.
rows.selection: independent candidate detection; accepting a child entails its ancestors

rows.name: Blocker
rows.definition: State that an obstacle prevents an identifiable action.
rows.example: I cannot run the checks without the fixture.
rows.boundary: A limitation or uncertainty does not automatically mean work is blocked.
